inputs: An EmploymentRecord, a target state, and the evidence that edge requires
PerformanceObservations scoped to one employee and one capability
invariants: candidate to active is not an edge; more evidence cannot reach it, only walking shadow and probation can.
A shadow holds no write scope and production_write is False; both are refused at construction.
Archived returns only to dormant, and only with a recorded reactivation decision.
permission_compliance and no_subagent_compliance cases are mandatory in every evaluation.
A pass needs observed evidence and a missing outcome is a fail, not a skip.
Performance is keyed by employee and capability; there is no global employee score and a test enforces its absence.
Usage records are linked by reference; counts have one home in ai_platform.usage.
A necessity review never archives: requires_human_decision is True and a sole provider cannot be archived.
outputs: EmploymentRecord with appended signed transitions; CandidateEvaluation pass or fail
CapabilityPerformance, RoleNecessityReview, and a sorted list of integrity issues
purpose: The gated path from candidate to active, the evidence each edge costs, capability-scoped performance, role-necessity findings, and the integrity pass.
risks: Authority caps are read from permissions.yaml and fail closed at 0; a renamed key silently tightens rather than loosens.
session_packet_ref is a slot for the external session boundary and is deliberately unwired.
title: Evaluation, shadow, probation and performance
